title: ceanothus divergens subsp. occidentalis
intro: Ceanothus divergens subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Bluebrush or California lilac, is a shrubby evergreen plant native to the southwestern United States and Baja California. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe sore throats, coughs, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Bluebrush include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to loosen and clear mucus from the airways, and its antiseptic properties, which aid in wound healing and preventing infection. The bioactive constituents of Ceanothus divergens subsp. occidentalis include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
